name: The Wake
tagline: A funeral for a man who never sold: an open casket that shows only his folded hands around a phone still glowing, a celebrant whose eulogy deepens with the round multiplier and a widow whose knuckles whiten on his folded lawn chair. Slip out the side door with two sandwiches and the commemorative candle before the phone in the casket buzzes, because the notification that ends the round is DEV SOLD.
